turns.text: There's a, there's a freedom to enjoy them as individuals, to watch them grow.
turns.zh: 有一种自由，就是享受他们作为独立个体的样子，看着他们成长。

turns.text: And I think that's been the case for me and my mom as well.
turns.zh: 我觉得我和我妈之间也是这样。

turns.text: With your girls, though, has that been comfortable for you?
turns.zh: 不过，对你女儿们来说，你适应得还好吗？

turns.text: The idea of stepping back from that manager role and letting them lead, letting them be the people who make you and your husband, as you say, weak martinis when you come and visit their apartment.
turns.zh: 就是那种从管理者角色退后、让她们自己做主、让她们成为那种——就像你说的——你和你丈夫去她们公寓做客时，她们给你们调淡马天尼的人。

turns.text: I couldn't stop laughing when I read that.
turns.zh: 我读到那段的时候笑得停不下来。

turns.text: It is a hard thing to do to let your kids be.
turns.zh: 让孩子自己做主，真的很难。
